title: An elder Kindred with Celerity and Potence
note: SANDBOX: an elder's body with Celerity (speed) and Potence (strength): a jump of 3 m, a sprint of 9 m/s reached in 0.15 s, falls of about 15 m unharmed, vaults to 3 m (a sprint vaults 1.0 m by 0.7 m and a run steps over 0.5 m, as every body), a resting supernatural speed of 9 m/s, mantles to 4 m, ledges grabbed to 5.5 m (reach 2.5 m plus the jump). The engine's research numbers until the rules package's curves; unbound only. SafeFall: 4 (the elder's multiplier) x 4.0 m (the larger of its jump, 3 m, and its MantleMax, 4 m) = 16.0 m. StartStopHalfLife: 0.1 s, quicker to start and stop than the human's 0.2 (held to the human's in the masquerade).
